#!/bin/sh /etc/rc.common

USE_PROCD=1

BINLOADER_BIN="/sbin/sec_monitor"


SE_LOG_FILE=/logs/selog2

getSrc4()
{
    ri_tool_name=/usr/sbin/ritool
    src4=$(${ri_tool_name} get LabelCode)
    if [ $? != 0 ];then
        src4="execute_failed"
    else
        src4=${src4#*:}
    fi
    if [ "${src4}x" = " 00000000x" -o "${src4}x" = "execute_failedx" ];then
        src4="invalid_key_src4_str"
    fi
    echo "src4:"${src4} >>${SE_LOG_FILE} 2>&1
    echo ${src4}
}

sec_db_init()
{
    ri_tool_name=/usr/sbin/ritool
    sec_db_tool=/sbin/sec_cli
    SEC_EXTFS_TOOL=sec_extfs
    src1=$(${ri_tool_name} get G984Serial)
    src2=$(${ri_tool_name} get ProgDate)
    src3=$(${ri_tool_name} get Mnemonic)
    src4=$(getSrc4)
    ${SEC_EXTFS_TOOL} -t all -o ${SEC_EXTFS_HASH_FILE}

    echo "src1:"${src1} >>${SE_LOG_FILE} 2>&1
    echo "src2:"${src2} >>${SE_LOG_FILE} 2>&1
    echo "src3:"${src3} >>${SE_LOG_FILE} 2>&1
    
    ${sec_db_tool} sedb -1 "${src1#*:}" -2 "${src2#*:}" -3 "${src3#*:}" -4 "${src4}" -e "${SEC_EXTFS_HASH_FILE}" >>${SE_LOG_FILE} 2>&1
    ${SEC_EXTFS_TOOL} -t mft -i boot
    echo "init securitydb success" >>${SE_LOG_FILE} 2>&1
}

boot()
{
    BOOT=1
    sec_db_init
    start "$@"
}

start_service()
{
    procd_open_instance
    procd_set_param respawn
    procd_set_param command $BINLOADER_BIN -c /usr/etc/se.conf
    procd_close_instance
}
stop_service()
{
    rm -f /tmp/run_se_mn.pid
}

restart()
{
    stop
    start
}

#!/bin/sh /etc/rc.common

START=00
STOP=99

. /usr/exe/backdefault.sh
. /usr/exe/data_guardian.sh
. /usr/exe/link.sh
. /usr/exe/varset.sh

current=$(uenv_get active_part)
standby=$(( 1 - $current ))
BACKUP_OVERLAY_MOUNT_DIR=/tmp/backup_overlay
no_cfg_env=0
cfg_partition=`/usr/sbin/fw_printenv|grep cfg_partition`

mount_backup_overlay()
{
	backup_overlay_mtd=$(cat /proc/mtd |grep rootfs_data$standby |cut -d: -f 1 |cut -c4-)

	$UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m $backup_overlay_mtd -d $backup_overlay_mtd &>/dev/null
	mdev -s &>/dev/null
	mkdir -p $BACKUP_OVERLAY_MOUNT_DIR
	mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${backup_overlay_mtd}_0 $BACKUP_OVERLAY_MOUNT_DIR &>/dev/null
	[ -e /configs/bosa ] || mkdir -p /configs/bosa
	[ -e $BACKUP_OVERLAY_MOUNT_DIR/upper/config/bosa/cfg.bob ] && mv -f $BACKUP_OVERLAY_MOUNT_DIR/upper/config/bosa/cfg.bob /configs/bosa/cfg.bob && sync
	umount $BACKUP_OVERLAY_MOUNT_DIR &>/dev/null
	$UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m $backup_overlay_mtd &>/dev/null
	rm -rf $BACKUP_OVERLAY_MOUNT_DIR
}

restore_configs()
{
	[ -e /configs/sysupgrade.tgz ] && tar -xzf /configs/sysupgrade.tgz -C / && rm -f /configs/sysupgrade.tgz
}

upgrade_logsize()
{
	SIZELIMIT=32768
	log_size=$(ls -al $UPGRADELOG 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $5}')
	[ $log_size -ge $SIZELIMIT ] && mv $UPGRADELOG $UPGRADELOGBAK
}

version_check()
{
	threshold=4
	if [ $(uenv_get bootfail${standby}) -ge ${threshold} ]; then
		echo "WARNING: bootfail${standby} is more than ${threshold}, set buildinfo null" >> $UPGRADELOG
		sed -i "s/=.*$/=null/g" $BACKUPROOTFSINFO
	fi

	currentImgVersion=$(cat /etc/buildinfo | grep IMAGEVERSION | cut -d'=' -f2)
	standbyImgVersion=$(cat $BACKUPROOTFSINFO | grep IMAGEVERSION | cut -d'=' -f2)

	img_current=$(uenv_get img_version$current)
	if [ $? != 0 -o "X$img_current" != "X$currentImgVersion" ]; then
		uenv_set img_version$current $currentImgVersion
	fi

	img_standby=$(uenv_get img_version$standby)
	if [ $? != 0 -o "X$img_standby" != "X$standbyImgVersion" ]; then
		uenv_set img_version$standby $standbyImgVersion
	fi
}

mount_backup_rootfs_partition()
{
	backup_mtd=$(cat /proc/mtd |grep -w rootfs$standby |cut -d: -f1 |cut -c4-)

	echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mount backup rootfs mtd: $backup_mtd start ..." | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/null
	$UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m $backup_mtd -d $backup_mtd &> /dev/null
	[ $? != 0 ] && echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]$UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m $backup_mtd -d $backup_mtd failed " | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
	mdev -s &>/dev/null
	$UBIBLOCK --create /dev/ubi${backup_mtd}_1 &>/dev/null
	[ ! -e /dev/ubiblock${backup_mtd}_1 ] && echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: $UBIBLOCK --create /dev/ubiblock${backup_mtd}_1 failed" | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
	mdev -s &>/dev/null
	mkdir -p /tmp/backup_rootfs
	mount -t squashfs -root /dev/ubiblock${backup_mtd}_1 /tmp/backup_rootfs &>/dev/null
	[ $? != 0 ] && echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mount -t squashfs -root /dev/ubiblock${backup_mtd}_1 /tmp/backup_rootfs failed" | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console

	cat /tmp/backup_rootfs/etc/buildinfo > $BACKUPROOTFSINFO
	# if mount backup rootfs failed, reboot and try again
	#[ -s $BACKUPROOTFSINFO ] || echo "MSG: mount backup rootfs failed" >/dev/console && reboot
	umount -l /tmp/backup_rootfs
	$UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m $backup_mtd &>/dev/null
	rm -rf /tmp/backup_rootfs
}


_mount_ubifs()
{
    ubi_map=$1
    ubi_part=$(echo "${ubi_map}" |cut -d: -f1)
    ubi_seed=$(echo "${ubi_map}" |cut -d: -f2)
    ubi_port=$(echo "${ubi_map}" |cut -d: -f3)
    echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_port=${ubi_port}" |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
    if grep -q "\<${ubi_part}\>" /proc/mtd; then
        echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mount $ubi_port start ..." | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/null
        ubi_part_id=$(cat /proc/mtd |grep "\<${ubi_part}\>"|head -n 1 |cut -d: -f1 |cut -c4-)
        echo "CMD: $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id}" &>/dev/console
        $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id} &>/dev/null
        mdev -s &>/dev/null

            ## try to mount the ${ubi_part} to the ${ubi_port}
            echo "CMD: mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_${ubi_seed} ${ubi_port}" &>/dev/console
            mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_${ubi_seed} ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
            ubi_err=$?
            echo "MSG: mount /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_${ubi_seed} ${ubi_port} with code=${ubi_err}" &>/dev/null

            ## check the mount ${ubi_port} size
            ubi_size=$(df -k |grep "\<ubi${ubi_part_id}_[012]\>" |sed "s/ [ \t]*/:/g"|cut -d: -f2)
            echo "MSG: ${ubi_port} size is ${ubi_size}KB" &>/dev/console
            if [ "0${ubi_size}" -lt 768 ]; then ubi_err=$((${ubi_err} + 1)); fi

            ## try to touch/write the mounted folder ${ubi_port}
            [ $ubi_err -eq 0 ] && touch ${ubi_port}/${TAGUBIFSWR}
            ubi_err=$((${ubi_err} + $?))
            echo "MSG: touch ${ubi_port}/${TAGUBIFSWR} with code=${ubi_err}" &>/dev/null

            ## check whether here is any error to try to recover
            if [ ${ubi_err} != 0 ]; then
                ## set fail flag to check if need to recover data
                uenv_set mount_$(echo $ubi_port | cut -d'/' -f 2)_fail 1
                echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: Partition ${ubi_part} damaged! Try to recover ..." |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
                echo "CMD: umount ${ubi_port}"
                umount -l ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id}"
                $UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y"
                $UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id}"
                ubi_part_info=$($UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id} 2>/dev/null)
                ubi_part_lebs=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(total\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*\(available\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
                ubi_part_aleb=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(available\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
                ubi_lebs_size=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(LEB size\).*\(bytes (\)\(.*\)\( KiB\).*/\3/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g" |cut -d. -f1)
                echo "MSG: ${ubi_part_info}"
                echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_part_lebs=${ubi_part_lebs} ubi_part_aleb=${ubi_part_aleb}"
                ## Volume Size = Total - Total/32(Reserved for BEB) - 4(Reserved for Volume)
                ## ubi_part_aleb=$((${ubi_part_aleb} - 4)) ## Reserved only for more tolerance
                ubi_vols_lebs=$((${ubi_part_lebs} * 31 / 32 - 4))
                if [ ${ubi_part_aleb} -lt ${ubi_vols_lebs} ]; then ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_part_aleb}; fi
                ubi_vols_size=$((${ubi_vols_lebs} * ${ubi_lebs_size}))
                echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_vols_lebs} ubi_lebs_size=${ubi_lebs_size} ubi_vols_size=${ubi_vols_size}"
                mdev -s &>/dev/null

                ## try to make volume for the ${ubi_part}
                echo "CMD: $UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB"
                $UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB &>/dev/null
                if [ $? != 0 ]; then reboot; fi    #reboot and try again
                mdev -s &>/dev/null

                ## try to mount the ${ubi_part}
                echo "CMD: mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port}"
                mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
            fi
            echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mount $ubi_port completed" | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
    fi
}

mount_partition()
{
	echo -e "\n[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: load ubi parts @`uptime`" |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console

	UBI_MAP_LIST="log:0:/logs user_data:0:/opt"
    if [ -z $cfg_partition ];then
	    echo  "no cfg_partition paramter in uboot env, so set cfg_partition to rootfs_data$current." |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
        /usr/sbin/fw_setenv cfg_partition rootfs_data$current
        no_cfg_env=1

	UBI_MAP_LIST=$UBI_MAP_LIST" $cfg_partition:0:/configs"
    echo $UBI_MAP_LIST|tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console

check_abnormal_reboot()
{
	reboot_data=$(devmem 0xf4320114)
	let "panic=(reboot_data>>16) & 0x01"
	let "kernel=(reboot_data>>18) & 0x01"
	let "app=(reboot_data>>19) & 0x01"
	let "watchdog=(reboot_data>>20) & 0x01"

	sb_para=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
	let "sb0_data=sb_para & 0x09"
	let "sb1_data=(sb_para>>4) & 0x09"

	echo "check_abnormal_reboot start" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	echo "data_panic:${panic} data_kernel:${kernel} data_app:${app} data_wdt:${watchdog} sb_flag:${sb_para} " |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console

	if [ "X$panic" == "X1" ]||[ "X$watchdog" == "X1" ]||[ "X$kernel" == "X1" ]&&[ "X$app" == "X0" ];then
		echo "ont started abnormally last time" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
		if [ [ "Xsb0_data" == "X9" ] || [ "Xsb1_data" == "X9" ] ];then
			echo "rollback to the backup partition" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
			backupversion="null"
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv img_version$standby $backupversion &>/dev/null

			sb_num=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
			if [ $current -eq 0 ]; then
				let "sb_data=sb_num & 0xDF"
			else
				let "sb_data=sb_num & 0xFD"
			fi
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv sb_flag $sb_data &>/dev/null
		fi
	fi

	sb_info=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
	backup_version=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n img_version$standby)
	echo "after: sb_info:${sb_info} backup_ver:${backup_version}" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	echo "check_abnormal_reboot end" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
}

max_time() {
	local file newest

	for file in $( find /logs -type f ) ; do
		[ -z "$newest" -o "$newest" -ot "$file" ] && newest=$file
	done
	[ "$newest" ] && date -r "$newest" +%s
}

sync_time() {
	local maxtime="$(max_time)"
	local curtime="$(date +%s)"

	[ $curtime -lt $maxtime ] && date -s @$maxtime
}

kmsg_init()
{
	if [ -e /logs/reboot.log ]; then
		filesize=$(du -c /logs/reboot.log |grep total |awk '{ print $1 }')
		if [ $filesize -gt 450 ]; then
			[ -e /logs/reboot.log.tar.gz ] && rm /logs/reboot.log.tar.gz
			cd /logs; mv -f reboot.log reboot.bak ; tar zcvf reboot.log.tar.gz  reboot.bak; cd -
			rm /logs/reboot.bak
			/bin/cat /etc/buildinfo |tee -a /logs/reboot.log &>/dev/console
		fi
	fi
	if [ -e /lib/modules/*/kmsg.ko ]; then
		insmod /lib/modules/*/kmsg.ko
	fi
}

_remount_configs()
{
    if [ "$cfg_partition" != "rootfs_data$current" ];then
        echo "old configs: $cfg_partition, now it's rootfs_data$current" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
        /usr/sbin/fw_setenv cfg_partition rootfs_data$current
        cfg_partition="rootfs_data$current"
        umount -l /configs
        _mount_ubifs "$cfg_partition:0:/configs"
    fi
}


_restore_configs_overlay()
{
    # delete old backup directory
    rm -rf /logs/.backup
    # delete old persisten files
    rm -rf $CONFIGS_OVERLAY

    mv /configs/sysupgrade.tgz /tmp
    #copy data in old cfg partition
    mkdir /tmp/cfg_data
    _mount_ubifs "cfg:0:/tmp/cfg_data"
    cp -rf /tmp/cfg_data/* /configs/
    umount -l /tmp/cfg_data 
    rm -rf /tmp/cfg_data

    # copy persisten files from previous rootfs
    mkdir /tmp/rootfs_data
    tar -xzf /tmp/sysupgrade.tgz -C /tmp/rootfs_data
    mkdir $CONFIGS_OVERLAY
    List=$(/usr/exe/json_paser OverlayParams.OverlayPersistentFileList < /etc/HB_Config.json)
    for file in $List
    do
        targetDir=$CONFIGS_OVERLAY/$(dirname $file)
         
        #first, copy from /rom, then overwrite from previous build (sysupgrade.tgz)
        [ -d /rom/$file ] && mkdir -p $targetDir && cp -rf /rom/$file  $targetDir
        [ -e /tmp/rootfs_data/$file ] && mkdir -p $targetDir && cp -rf /tmp/rootfs_data/$file  $targetDir
        echo "[ -e /tmp/rootfs_data/$file ] && cp -rf /tmp/rootfs_data/$file  $targetDir" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
    done

    rm -rf /tmp/rootfs_data
    rm -f /tmp/sysupgrade.tgz
 }

upgrade_from_less_2303()
{
    tmp_version=$(cat $BACKUPROOTFSINFO | grep -w IMAGEVERSION | cut -d'=' -f2)
    release_str=${tmp_version:9:3}

    IS_UPGRADE=$(is_upgrade)
    echo "$release_str $IS_UPGRADE" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
    if [ "$release_str" \< "JKK" -a $IS_UPGRADE -eq 1 ];then
        echo "upgrade from old build which is before 2303!" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
        _remount_configs
        _restore_configs_overlay
    elif [ $no_cfg_env -eq 1 ];then
        echo "no cfg_partition in uboot env!" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
        _restore_configs_overlay
    fi
}

check_logs_partition()
{
        ubi_logs="log:0:/logs"
        mtd=$(echo $ubi_logs | cut -d: -f 1)
        usage=$(df /logs | tail -1 | awk '{print $5}' | sed 's/%//g')
        if [ "$usage" -ge 99 ]; then
                echo "MSG: logs is used over 99%, format and remount it" &>/dev/console
                format_partition $mtd
                #_mount_ubifs $ubi_logs
        fi
}

{
	mount_partition
	mount_backup_rootfs_partition
	sync_time
	factory_back_default
	upgrade_from_less_2303
	link_after_overlay 
	/bin/sh /usr/exe/upgrade_check.sh &>/dev/console
	#version_check

#!/bin/sh

###########################################################################
## this script define the behavior of reset button
## one click:                  reboot system (OPID is not 0000)
## double click:               deep factory default reset
## press hold more than 10s:   factory default reset
###########################################################################

. /lib/functions/leds.sh
. /lib/functions.sh
. /usr/exe/varset.sh

PRESS_HOLD_TIME=10
RESET_FILE=/configs/fresetOriginator.txt

CUR_HOLD_TIME=/tmp/btn_cur_hold_time
LAST_HOLD_TIME=/tmp/btn_last_hold_time

# INTERVAL TIME means last release to next press
INTERVAL_TIME=/tmp/btn_interval_time
BTN_ACTION=/tmp/btn_action

opid=$(ritool get OperatorID | awk '{print $2}')

led_ctrl()
{
    press_time=`date +%s`
    while [ true ]
    do
    {
        cur_time=`date +%s`
        case "$(cat $BTN_ACTION)" in
            "pressed")
                hold_time=`expr $cur_time - $press_time`
                if [ $hold_time -ge $PRESS_HOLD_TIME ];then
                    ledtool allon
                    sleep 3
                    led_hold_time=`expr $PRESS_HOLD_TIME + 1`
                    export ACTION="released"
                    export SEEN="$led_hold_time"
                    /etc/rc.button/reset
                    exit 0
                else
                    ledtool allblink
                fi
            ;;
            "released")
            exit 0
            ;;
        esac
    }
    done
}

is_double_click()
{
    if [ $(cat $LAST_HOLD_TIME) -lt 1 -a $(cat $CUR_HOLD_TIME) -lt 1 -a $(cat $INTERVAL_TIME) -eq 0 ]
    then
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

one_click_check()
{
    release_time=`date +%s`
    while [ true ]
    do
        cur_time=`date +%s`
        # if INTERVAL_TIME is 0, means double click
        if [ $(cat $INTERVAL_TIME) -eq 0 -o $(cat $BTN_ACTION) = "pressed" ];then exit 0; fi

        # if no press action after release 1s, means one click
        interval_time=`expr $cur_time - $release_time`
        if [ $(cat $INTERVAL_TIME) -gt 0 -a $interval_time -gt 1 ];then
            if [ "X$opid" = "X0000" ]; then
                echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: Reset button pressed" |tee -a /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
            else
                echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: REBOOT due to reset button click" |tee -a /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
                reboot
            fi
            exit 0
        fi
    done
}

deep_fac_reset()
{
    echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: Deep factory default reset due to reset button double click" |tee -a /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
    /usr/sbin/ledtool allblink
    /usr/exe/factory-default-reset all
}

case "${ACTION}" in
    "pressed")
        [ -e $CUR_HOLD_TIME ] && cat $CUR_HOLD_TIME > $LAST_HOLD_TIME
        echo $SEEN > $INTERVAL_TIME
        echo "${ACTION}" > $BTN_ACTION
        led_ctrl &
    ;;
    "released")
        echo "${ACTION}" > $BTN_ACTION
        echo $SEEN > $CUR_HOLD_TIME

        is_double_click
        if [ $? -eq 1 ];then deep_fac_reset; exit 0; fi

        if [ $(cat $CUR_HOLD_TIME) -ge $PRESS_HOLD_TIME ]; then
            if [ ! -f "$RESET_FILE" ]; then
                touch $RESET_FILE
                echo "LocalFactoryReset" > $RESET_FILE
            fi
            echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: FACTORY RESET due to reset button click more than 10s" |tee -a /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
            cfgcli backupkeyparam
			/usr/exe/factory-default-reset
        elif [ $(cat $CUR_HOLD_TIME) -lt 1 ];then
            one_click_check &
        else
            reboot
        fi
    ;;
esac

format_partition()
{
	ubi_part=$1
	echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: format partition $ubi_part ..." | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console

	ubi_part_id=$(cat /proc/mtd |grep "\<${ubi_part}\>"|head -n 1 |cut -d: -f1 |cut -c4-)
	ubi_port=$(mount |grep /dev/ubi$ubi_part_id |cut -d' ' -f3)
	echo "CMD: umount ${ubi_port}"
	umount -l ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
	echo "CMD: $UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id}"
	$UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} &>/dev/null
	echo "CMD: $UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y"
	$UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y &>/dev/null
	echo "CMD: $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id}"
	ubi_part_info=$($UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id} 2>/dev/null)
	ubi_part_lebs=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(total\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*\(available\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
	ubi_part_aleb=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(available\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
	ubi_lebs_size=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(LEB size\).*\(bytes (\)\(.*\)\( KiB\).*/\3/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g" |cut -d. -f1)
	echo "MSG: ${ubi_part_info}"
	echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_part_lebs=${ubi_part_lebs} ubi_part_aleb=${ubi_part_aleb}"
	## Volume Size = Total - Total/32(Reserved for BEB) - 4(Reserved for Volume)
	## ubi_part_aleb=$((${ubi_part_aleb} - 4)) ## Reserved only for more tolerance
	ubi_vols_lebs=$((${ubi_part_lebs} * 31 / 32 - 4))
	if [ ${ubi_part_aleb} -lt ${ubi_vols_lebs} ]; then ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_part_aleb}; fi
	ubi_vols_size=$((${ubi_vols_lebs} * ${ubi_lebs_size}))
	echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_vols_lebs} ubi_lebs_size=${ubi_lebs_size} ubi_vols_size=${ubi_vols_size}"
	mdev -s &>/dev/null

	## try to make volume for the ${ubi_part}
	echo "CMD: $UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB"
	$UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB &>/dev/null
	if [ $? != 0 ]; then reboot; fi    #reboot and try again
	mdev -s &>/dev/null

	## try to mount the ${ubi_part}
	echo "CMD: mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port}"
	mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null

	echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: format partition $ubi_part done" | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
}

factory_back_default()

	default_logs2tmp
    cfg_partition=`/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n cfg_partition`
	UBIDIR_CFGLOG_LIST="$cfg_partition:configs log:logs"
	UBIDIR_CFGOPT_LIST="$cfg_partition:configs log:logs user_data:opt"
	loop=0; while [ $loop -le 9 ]
	do
		RESET_FLAG=`/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n factory_reset_flag`
		if [ ! -z "${RESET_FLAG}" ]; then break; fi
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]ERR: get factory_reset_flag but failed $loop times ..." |tee -a /tmp/$LOGDEFAULT &>/dev/console
		sync; mdev -s &>/dev/null
		loop=$(( $loop + 1 ))
	done
	if [ -z "${RESET_FLAG}" -a $loop -ge 9 ]; then
		RESET_FLAG=0
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]ERR: get factory_reset_flag timeout, assigned as 0" |tee -a /tmp/$LOGDEFAULT &>/dev/console
	fi
	echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: RESET flag $RESET_FLAG" |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
	if [ $RESET_FLAG -eq 1 ]; then
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: factory default reset ..." |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
		for list in $UBIDIR_CFGLOG_LIST; do
			dir=$(echo $list |cut -d: -f 2)
			backup_DeepWhiteList $dir
			backup_NormalWhiteList $dir
			echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: Factory reset clear $dir ..." |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
			rm -rf /$dir/*
			restore_DeepWhiteList $dir
			restore_NormalWhiteList $dir
		done
		remove_ExtraBlackList
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: factory default reset completed!" |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
	elif [ $RESET_FLAG -eq 2 ]; then
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: deep factory default reset ..." |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
		for list in $UBIDIR_CFGOPT_LIST; do
			dir=$(echo $list | cut -d: -f 2)
			mtd=$(echo $list | cut -d: -f 1)
			backup_DeepWhiteList $dir
			format_partition $mtd
			restore_DeepWhiteList $dir
		done
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: deep factory default reset completed!" |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
	fi
	loop=0; while [ $loop -lt 9 ]
	do
		/usr/sbin/fw_setenv factory_reset_flag 0
		sync; loop=$(( $loop + 1 ))
		if [ "X"`/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n factory_reset_flag` = "X0" ]; then break; fi
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]ERR: factory-default set flag to 0 but failed $loop times ..." |tee -a /tmp/$LOGDEFAULT &>/dev/console
	done
	default_tmp2logs
}

_mount_ubifs()
{
    ubi_map=$1
    ubi_part=$(echo "${ubi_map}" |cut -d: -f1)
    ubi_seed=$(echo "${ubi_map}" |cut -d: -f2)
    ubi_port=$(echo "${ubi_map}" |cut -d: -f3)
    echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_port=${ubi_port}" |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
    if grep -q "\<${ubi_part}\>" /proc/mtd; then
        echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mount $ubi_port start ..." | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/null
        ubi_part_id=$(cat /proc/mtd |grep "\<${ubi_part}\>"|head -n 1 |cut -d: -f1 |cut -c4-)
        echo "CMD: $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id}" &>/dev/console
        $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id} &>/dev/null
        mdev -s &>/dev/null

            ## try to mount the ${ubi_part} to the ${ubi_port}
            echo "CMD: mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_${ubi_seed} ${ubi_port}" &>/dev/console
            mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_${ubi_seed} ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
            ubi_err=$?
            echo "MSG: mount /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_${ubi_seed} ${ubi_port} with code=${ubi_err}" &>/dev/null

            ## check the mount ${ubi_port} size
            ubi_size=$(df -k |grep "\<ubi${ubi_part_id}_[012]\>" |sed "s/ [ \t]*/:/g"|cut -d: -f2)
            echo "MSG: ${ubi_port} size is ${ubi_size}KB" &>/dev/console
            if [ "0${ubi_size}" -lt 768 ]; then ubi_err=$((${ubi_err} + 1)); fi

            ## try to touch/write the mounted folder ${ubi_port}
            [ $ubi_err -eq 0 ] && touch ${ubi_port}/${TAGUBIFSWR}
            ubi_err=$((${ubi_err} + $?))
            echo "MSG: touch ${ubi_port}/${TAGUBIFSWR} with code=${ubi_err}" &>/dev/null

            ## check whether here is any error to try to recover
            if [ ${ubi_err} != 0 ]; then
                ## set fail flag to check if need to recover data
                uenv_set mount_$(echo $ubi_port | cut -d'/' -f 2)_fail 1
                echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: Partition ${ubi_part} damaged! Try to recover ..." |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
                echo "CMD: umount ${ubi_port}"
                umount -l ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id}"
                $UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y"
                $UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y &>/dev/null
                echo "CMD: $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id}"
                ubi_part_info=$($UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id} 2>/dev/null)
                ubi_part_lebs=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(total\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*\(available\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
                ubi_part_aleb=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(available\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
                ubi_lebs_size=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(LEB size\).*\(bytes (\)\(.*\)\( KiB\).*/\3/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g" |cut -d. -f1)
                echo "MSG: ${ubi_part_info}"
                echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_part_lebs=${ubi_part_lebs} ubi_part_aleb=${ubi_part_aleb}"
                ## Volume Size = Total - Total/32(Reserved for BEB) - 4(Reserved for Volume)
                ## ubi_part_aleb=$((${ubi_part_aleb} - 4)) ## Reserved only for more tolerance
                ubi_vols_lebs=$((${ubi_part_lebs} * 31 / 32 - 4))
                if [ ${ubi_part_aleb} -lt ${ubi_vols_lebs} ]; then ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_part_aleb}; fi
                ubi_vols_size=$((${ubi_vols_lebs} * ${ubi_lebs_size}))
                echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_vols_lebs} ubi_lebs_size=${ubi_lebs_size} ubi_vols_size=${ubi_vols_size}"
                mdev -s &>/dev/null

                ## try to make volume for the ${ubi_part}
                echo "CMD: $UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB"
                $UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB &>/dev/null
                if [ $? != 0 ]; then reboot; fi    #reboot and try again
                mdev -s &>/dev/null

                ## try to mount the ${ubi_part}
                echo "CMD: mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port}"
                mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
            fi
            echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: mount $ubi_port completed" | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
    fi
}

check_abnormal_reboot()

	reboot_data=$(devmem 0xf4320114)
	let "panic=(reboot_data>>16) & 0x01"
	let "kernel=(reboot_data>>18) & 0x01"
	let "app=(reboot_data>>19) & 0x01"
	let "watchdog=(reboot_data>>20) & 0x01"

	sb_para=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
	let "sb0_data=sb_para & 0x09"
	let "sb1_data=(sb_para>>4) & 0x09"

	echo "check_abnormal_reboot start" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	echo "data_panic:${panic} data_kernel:${kernel} data_app:${app} data_wdt:${watchdog} sb_flag:${sb_para} " |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console

	if [ "X$panic" == "X1" ]||[ "X$watchdog" == "X1" ]||[ "X$kernel" == "X1" ]&&[ "X$app" == "X0" ];then
		echo "ont started abnormally last time" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
		if [ [ "Xsb0_data" == "X9" ] || [ "Xsb1_data" == "X9" ] ];then
			echo "rollback to the backup partition" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
			backupversion="null"
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv img_version$standby $backupversion &>/dev/null

			sb_num=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
			if [ $current -eq 0 ]; then
				let "sb_data=sb_num & 0xDF"
			else
				let "sb_data=sb_num & 0xFD"
			fi
			/usr/sbin/fw_setenv sb_flag $sb_data &>/dev/null
		fi
	fi

	sb_info=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
	backup_version=$(usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n img_version$standby)
	echo "after: sb_info:${sb_info} backup_ver:${backup_version}" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
	echo "check_abnormal_reboot end" |tee -a ${SYSLOGS} &>/dev/console
}

#!/bin/sh

###########################################################################
## this script define the behavior of reset button
## one click:                  reboot system (OPID is not 0000)
## double click:               deep factory default reset
## press hold more than 10s:   factory default reset
###########################################################################

. /lib/functions/leds.sh
. /lib/functions.sh
. /usr/exe/varset.sh

PRESS_HOLD_TIME=10
RESET_FILE=/configs/fresetOriginator.txt

CUR_HOLD_TIME=/tmp/btn_cur_hold_time
LAST_HOLD_TIME=/tmp/btn_last_hold_time

# INTERVAL TIME means last release to next press
INTERVAL_TIME=/tmp/btn_interval_time
BTN_ACTION=/tmp/btn_action

opid=$(ritool get OperatorID | awk '{print $2}')

led_ctrl()
{
    press_time=`date +%s`
    while [ true ]
    do
    {
        cur_time=`date +%s`
        case "$(cat $BTN_ACTION)" in
            "pressed")
                hold_time=`expr $cur_time - $press_time`
                if [ $hold_time -ge $PRESS_HOLD_TIME ];then
                    ledtool allon
                    sleep 3
                    led_hold_time=`expr $PRESS_HOLD_TIME + 1`
                    export ACTION="released"
                    export SEEN="$led_hold_time"
                    /etc/rc.button/reset
                    exit 0
                else
                    ledtool allblink
                fi
            ;;
            "released")
            exit 0
            ;;
        esac
    }
    done
}

is_double_click()
{
    if [ $(cat $LAST_HOLD_TIME) -lt 1 -a $(cat $CUR_HOLD_TIME) -lt 1 -a $(cat $INTERVAL_TIME) -eq 0 ]
    then
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

one_click_check()
{
    release_time=`date +%s`
    while [ true ]
    do
        cur_time=`date +%s`
        # if INTERVAL_TIME is 0, means double click
        if [ $(cat $INTERVAL_TIME) -eq 0 -o $(cat $BTN_ACTION) = "pressed" ];then exit 0; fi

        # if no press action after release 1s, means one click
        interval_time=`expr $cur_time - $release_time`
        if [ $(cat $INTERVAL_TIME) -gt 0 -a $interval_time -gt 1 ];then
            if [ "X$opid" = "X0000" ]; then
                echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: Reset button pressed" |tee -a /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
            else
                echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: REBOOT due to reset button click" |tee -a /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
                reboot
            fi
            exit 0
        fi
    done
}

deep_fac_reset()
{
    echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: Deep factory default reset due to reset button double click" |tee -a /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
    /usr/sbin/ledtool allblink
    /usr/exe/factory-default-reset all
}

case "${ACTION}" in
    "pressed")
        [ -e $CUR_HOLD_TIME ] && cat $CUR_HOLD_TIME > $LAST_HOLD_TIME
        echo $SEEN > $INTERVAL_TIME
        echo "${ACTION}" > $BTN_ACTION
        led_ctrl &
    ;;
    "released")
        echo "${ACTION}" > $BTN_ACTION
        echo $SEEN > $CUR_HOLD_TIME

        is_double_click
        if [ $? -eq 1 ];then deep_fac_reset; exit 0; fi

        if [ $(cat $CUR_HOLD_TIME) -ge $PRESS_HOLD_TIME ]; then
            if [ ! -f "$RESET_FILE" ]; then
                touch $RESET_FILE
                echo "LocalFactoryReset" > $RESET_FILE
            fi
            echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: FACTORY RESET due to reset button click more than 10s" |tee -a /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
            cfgcli backupkeyparam
			/usr/exe/factory-default-reset
        elif [ $(cat $CUR_HOLD_TIME) -lt 1 ];then
            one_click_check &
        else
            reboot
        fi
    ;;
esac

#!/bin/sh

. /usr/exe/varset.sh

BARDEFAULT=15000
default_logs2tmp()
{
	if [ ! -e /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} ]; then
		return
	fi
	SIZDEFAULT=$(ls -l /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} 2>/dev/null | sed "s/[!\t][ \t]*/ /g" | cut -d" " -f5)
	if [ "0${SIZDEFAULT}" -ge ${BARDEFAULT} ]; then
		mv -f /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} /logs/${BAKDEFAULT}
	else
		cat /logs/${LOGDEFAULT} /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} > /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT}.tmp
		mv -f /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT}.tmp /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT}
	fi
	if [ -f /logs/${BAKDEFAULT} ]; then
		mv -f /logs/${BAKDEFAULT} /tmp/${BAKDEFAULT}
	fi
}

default_tmp2logs()
{
	if [ -f /tmp/${BAKDEFAULT} ]; then mv -f /tmp/${BAKDEFAULT} /logs/${BAKDEFAULT}; fi
	if [ -f /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} ]; then mv -f /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} /logs/${LOGDEFAULT}; fi
}

format_partition()
{
	ubi_part=$1
	echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: format partition $ubi_part ..." | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console

	ubi_part_id=$(cat /proc/mtd |grep "\<${ubi_part}\>"|head -n 1 |cut -d: -f1 |cut -c4-)
	ubi_port=$(mount |grep /dev/ubi$ubi_part_id |cut -d' ' -f3)
	echo "CMD: umount ${ubi_port}"
	umount -l ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null
	echo "CMD: $UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id}"
	$UBIDETACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} &>/dev/null
	echo "CMD: $UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y"
	$UBIFORMAT /dev/mtd${ubi_part_id} -y &>/dev/null
	echo "CMD: $UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id}"
	ubi_part_info=$($UBIATTACH $UBIDEVCTL -m ${ubi_part_id} -d ${ubi_part_id} 2>/dev/null)
	ubi_part_lebs=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(total\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*\(available\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
	ubi_part_aleb=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(available\)\(.*\)\(LEBs\).*/\2/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g")
	ubi_lebs_size=$(echo "${ubi_part_info}" |sed "s/^.*\(LEB size\).*\(bytes (\)\(.*\)\( KiB\).*/\3/" |sed "s/[ \t\n]//g" |cut -d. -f1)
	echo "MSG: ${ubi_part_info}"
	echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_part_lebs=${ubi_part_lebs} ubi_part_aleb=${ubi_part_aleb}"
	## Volume Size = Total - Total/32(Reserved for BEB) - 4(Reserved for Volume)
	## ubi_part_aleb=$((${ubi_part_aleb} - 4)) ## Reserved only for more tolerance
	ubi_vols_lebs=$((${ubi_part_lebs} * 31 / 32 - 4))
	if [ ${ubi_part_aleb} -lt ${ubi_vols_lebs} ]; then ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_part_aleb}; fi
	ubi_vols_size=$((${ubi_vols_lebs} * ${ubi_lebs_size}))
	echo "MSG: ubi_part=${ubi_part} ubi_vols_lebs=${ubi_vols_lebs} ubi_lebs_size=${ubi_lebs_size} ubi_vols_size=${ubi_vols_size}"
	mdev -s &>/dev/null

	## try to make volume for the ${ubi_part}
	echo "CMD: $UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB"
	$UBIMKVOL /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id} -t dynamic -n 0 -N ${ubi_part} -s ${ubi_vols_size}KiB &>/dev/null
	if [ $? != 0 ]; then reboot; fi    #reboot and try again
	mdev -s &>/dev/null

	## try to mount the ${ubi_part}
	echo "CMD: mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port}"
	mount -t ubifs /dev/ubi${ubi_part_id}_0 ${ubi_port} &>/dev/null

	echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: format partition $ubi_part done" | tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
}

backup_DeepWhiteList()
{
	src=$1
	if [ "X$src" = "Xlogs" ]; then
		dst="configs"
	else
		dst="logs"
	fi
	whiteList=$(/usr/exe/json_paser FactoryResetParams.FactoryResetDeepWhiteList < /etc/HB_Config.json)
	for file in $whiteList; do
		root_dir=$(echo $file | sed -e 's/\// /g' | awk '{print $1}')
		if [ "X$root_dir" != "X$src" ]; then
			continue
		fi
		[ -e $file ] && cp -rf $file /$dst/
	done
	sync
}

	if [ "X$src" = "Xlogs" ]; then
		dst="configs"
	else

	fi

factory_back_default()
{
	default_logs2tmp
    cfg_partition=`/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n cfg_partition`
	UBIDIR_CFGLOG_LIST="$cfg_partition:configs log:logs"
	UBIDIR_CFGOPT_LIST="$cfg_partition:configs log:logs user_data:opt"
	loop=0; while [ $loop -le 9 ]
	do
		RESET_FLAG=`/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n factory_reset_flag`
		if [ ! -z "${RESET_FLAG}" ]; then break; fi
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]ERR: get factory_reset_flag but failed $loop times ..." |tee -a /tmp/$LOGDEFAULT &>/dev/console
		sync; mdev -s &>/dev/null
		loop=$(( $loop + 1 ))
	done
	if [ -z "${RESET_FLAG}" -a $loop -ge 9 ]; then
		RESET_FLAG=0
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]ERR: get factory_reset_flag timeout, assigned as 0" |tee -a /tmp/$LOGDEFAULT &>/dev/console
	fi
	echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: RESET flag $RESET_FLAG" |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
	if [ $RESET_FLAG -eq 1 ]; then
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: factory default reset ..." |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
		for list in $UBIDIR_CFGLOG_LIST; do
			dir=$(echo $list |cut -d: -f 2)
			backup_DeepWhiteList $dir
			backup_NormalWhiteList $dir
			echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: Factory reset clear $dir ..." |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
			rm -rf /$dir/*
			restore_DeepWhiteList $dir
			restore_NormalWhiteList $dir
		done
		remove_ExtraBlackList
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: factory default reset completed!" |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
	elif [ $RESET_FLAG -eq 2 ]; then
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: deep factory default reset ..." |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
		for list in $UBIDIR_CFGOPT_LIST; do
			dir=$(echo $list | cut -d: -f 2)
			mtd=$(echo $list | cut -d: -f 1)
			backup_DeepWhiteList $dir
			format_partition $mtd
			restore_DeepWhiteList $dir
		done
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: deep factory default reset completed!" |tee -a /tmp/${LOGDEFAULT} &>/dev/console
	fi

	link_after_overlay 

	loop=0; while [ $loop -lt 9 ]
	do
		/usr/sbin/fw_setenv factory_reset_flag 0
		sync; loop=$(( $loop + 1 ))
		if [ "X"`/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n factory_reset_flag` = "X0" ]; then break; fi
		echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]ERR: factory-default set flag to 0 but failed $loop times ..." |tee -a /tmp/$LOGDEFAULT &>/dev/console
	done
	default_tmp2logs
}

#we need to follow one rule 
#we need to add the count and background variable in the script
set -x

if [ $# -lt 1 ];then
	echo "no enough parameters"
	echo " usage:"
	echo "post_script.sh mount/driver/app"
	exit 1
fi

prefix=$1

if [ ! -f "/configs/${prefix}_post_script.sh" ];then
	echo "the post_script.sh is not exit , do not need to do anything byebye!"
	exit 1
fi

count=`cat /configs/${prefix}_post_script.sh |grep  count |awk -F "=" '{print $2}'`
background=`cat /configs/${prefix}_post_script.sh |grep background|awk -F "=" '{print $2}'`

if [ -z "$count" -o -z "$background" ];then
	echo "the script lost the count or background value"
	exit 1
fi

launch_script()
{
      chmod +x /tmp/${prefix}_post_script.sh
	if [ "$background" = 0 ];then
		/sbin/saferun /tmp/${prefix}_post_script.sh &
	else
		/sbin/saferun /tmp/${prefix}_post_script.sh
	fi
}

	cp -rfd /configs/${prefix}_post_script.sh /tmp/
if [ "$count" = 0 ];then
	rm -rf /configs/${prefix}_post_script.sh 
	chmod 755 /tmp/${prefix}_post_script.sh
	launch_script
	echo "run once ${prefix}_post_script.sh >> /logs/reboot.log"

elif [ "$count" -gt 0 -a "$count" -lt 100 ];then
	if [ -f "/configs/${prefix}_post_script_count" ];then
		count=`cat /configs/${prefix}_post_script_count|grep count|awk -F "=" '{print $2}'`
	fi
	
	if [ "$count" != 0 ];then
		launch_script
		let count-=1
		echo "count=$count" > /configs/${prefix}_post_script_count
		echo "run $count times ${prefix}_post_script.sh >> /logs/reboot.log"
	else
		rm -rf /configs/${prefix}_post_script.sh
		rm -rf /configs/${prefix}_post_script_count
		echo "run done the ${prefix}_post_script.sh >> /logs/reboot.log"
	fi
else
	launch_script
	date >> /logs/reboot.log
	echo "run again the ${prefix}_post_script.sh >> /logs/reboot.log"
fi

uenv_get()
{
    key=$1
    cmd="/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n $key"
    loop=0; while [ $loop -le 9 ]; do
        value=$($cmd)
        echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: $0 - $cmd = $value @ $loop" |tee -a $SYSLOGS &>/dev/console
        if [ ! -z "$value" ]; then echo $value; return 0; fi
        loop=$(( $loop + 1 ))
    done
    echo 0; return 1
}

uenv_set()
{
    key=$1
    value=$2
    cmd="/usr/sbin/fw_setenv $key $value"
    loop=0; while [ $loop -le 9 ]; do
        $cmd; sync
	retVal=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n $key)
        echo "[`date '+%F.%T%z'`]MSG: $0 - $cmd = $retVal @ $loop" |tee -a $SYSLOGS &>/dev/console
        if [ "X$value" = "X$retVal" ]; then return 0; fi
        loop=$(( $loop + 1 ))
    done
    return 1
}

is_upgrade()
{
    sb_num=$(/usr/sbin/fw_printenv -n sb_flag)
    let "sb_data=sb_num & 0x88"

    if [ $sb_data -eq 128 -o $sb_data -eq 8 ];then
        echo "1"
    else
        echo "0"
    fi
}
